% \vb is the perfect, the imperfect and the masdar, each with its
% transliteration, then the meaning (docs/lang/ar.md).  The perfect's sound
% carries the verb's form in brackets -- ḫaraja (I), arāda (IV) -- and the
% masdar is the verbal noun that goes with the sense, ruʾya for رَأَى "to
% see": this edition once wrote the perfect a second time in that slot, nine
% verbs out of nine, and printed "masdar رَأَى raʾā" in the PDF and the reader
% alike.  The preposition a verb governs rides in brackets after the meaning,
% (+ إِلَى) on وَصَلَ, whose chunk shows it.
\chapopen{١}

\parstart{١.١}{خَرَجَ الثَّعْلَبُ يَوْمًا فِي طَلَبِ الطَّعَامِ.}
\parnum{١.١}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{خَرَجَ الثَّعْلَبُ}{ḫaraja ṯ-ṯaʿlabu}{\vb{خَرَجَ}{ḫaraja (I)}{يَخْرُجُ}{yaḫruju}{خُرُوج}{ḫurūj}{to go out}; \dw{ثَعْلَب}{ṯaʿlab} fox, pl. \pw{ثَعَالِب}}{the fox went out}
\ch{}{يَوْمًا}{yawman}{\dw{يَوْم}{yawm} day, \nobreak+\,the accusative \textit{-an} of time: one day}{one day}
\ch{}{فِي طَلَبِ الطَّعَامِ.}{fī ṭalabi ṭ-ṭaʿāmi}{\dw{طَلَب}{ṭalab} seeking, search; \dw{طَعَام}{ṭaʿām} food}{in search of food.}
\end{frank}

\parnum{١.٢}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{فَرَأَى عُنْقُودًا}{fa-raʾā ʿunqūdan}{\pw{فَ} and so, then; \vb{رَأَى}{raʾā (I)}{يَرَى}{yarā}{رُؤْيَة}{ruʾya}{to see}; \dw{عُنْقُود}{ʿunqūd} bunch, cluster, pl. \pw{عَنَاقِيد}}{and he saw a bunch}
\ch{}{مِنَ الْعِنَبِ}{mina l-ʿinabi}{\dw{عِنَب}{ʿinab} grapes}{of grapes}
\ch{}{مُتَدَلِّيًا}{mutadalliyan}{\dw{مُتَدَلٍّ}{mutadallin} hanging down, the participle of \pw{تَدَلَّى}}{hanging}
\ch{}{مِنْ كَرْمَةٍ عَالِيَةٍ.}{min karmatin ʿāliyatin}{\dw{كَرْمَة}{karma} vine; \dw{عَالٍ}{ʿālin} high, fem. \pw{عَالِيَة}}{from a high vine.}
\end{frank}

\parnum{١.٣}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{فَقَفَزَ}{fa-qafaza}{\vb{قَفَزَ}{qafaza (I)}{يَقْفِزُ}{yaqfizu}{قَفْز}{qafz}{to jump}}{so he jumped}
\ch{}{مَرَّةً بَعْدَ مَرَّةٍ،}{marratan baʿda marratin}{\dw{مَرَّة}{marra} a time, once; \dw{بَعْدَ}{baʿda} after}{time after time,}
\ch{}{وَلَكِنَّهُ}{wa-lākinna-hu}{\dw{لَكِنَّ}{lākinna} but, \nobreak+\,the pronoun suffix \textit{-hu} he}{but he}
\ch{}{لَمْ يَصِلْ إِلَيْهِ.}{lam yaṣil ilay-hi}{\pw{لَمْ} did not, with the jussive; \vb{وَصَلَ}{waṣala (I)}{يَصِلُ}{yaṣilu}{وُصُول}{wuṣūl}{to reach, to arrive (+ \pw{إِلَى})}; \pw{إِلَى} to, \nobreak+\,\textit{-hi} it}{did not reach it.}
\end{frank}

\parend

\parstart{١.٢}{أَخِيرًا تَعِبَ الثَّعْلَبُ وَذَهَبَ.}
\parnum{٢.١}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{أَخِيرًا}{aḫīran}{\dw{أَخِير}{aḫīr} last, \nobreak+\,\textit{-an}: finally}{finally}
\ch{}{تَعِبَ الثَّعْلَبُ}{taʿiba ṯ-ṯaʿlabu}{\vb{تَعِبَ}{taʿiba (I)}{يَتْعَبُ}{yatʿabu}{تَعَب}{taʿab}{to get tired}}{the fox got tired}
\ch{}{وَذَهَبَ.}{wa-ḏahaba}{\vb{ذَهَبَ}{ḏahaba (I)}{يَذْهَبُ}{yaḏhabu}{ذَهَاب}{ḏahāb}{to go away}}{and went away.}
\end{frank}

\parnum{٢.٢}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{وَقَالَ}{wa-qāla}{\vb{قَالَ}{qāla (I)}{يَقُولُ}{yaqūlu}{قَوْل}{qawl}{to say}}{and he said}
\ch{}{وَهُوَ يَمْشِي:}{wa-huwa yamšī}{\pw{وَ} \nobreak+\,pronoun \nobreak+\,imperfect: while he was; \vb{مَشَى}{mašā (I)}{يَمْشِي}{yamšī}{مَشْي}{mašy}{to walk}}{as he walked:}
\ch{}{هَٰذَا الْعِنَبُ حَامِضٌ،}{hāḏā l-ʿinabu ḥāmiḍun}{\dw{هَٰذَا}{hāḏā} this, with the dagger alif of the school editions; \dw{حَامِض}{ḥāmiḍ} sour}{these grapes are sour,}
\ch{}{وَلَا أُرِيدُهُ.}{wa-lā urīdu-hu}{\pw{لَا} not, with the imperfect; \vb{أَرَادَ}{arāda (IV)}{يُرِيدُ}{yurīdu}{إِرَادَة}{irāda}{to want}}{and I do not want them.}
\end{frank}

\chapend
